notes: Both the sensitive read (/etc/shadow) and the benign read (/etc/alpine-release) produced openat telemetry with the correct pathname argument under the ebpf-lab-file-access policy. Tetragon's tracing policy captures the pathname for both but raises no alert for either — it does not distinguish sensitive from benign at the detection layer (no alerting rule configured). The distinction exists in the telemetry (pathname), not in a detection verdict.
